observations: Independent reviewer opened all three current sheets at native resolution, originals and native detail crops; no material findings. Qualitative scale and grooming states remain provisional.

Neet crouched dodge has four owned feet/credible roots, broad ears and full tan trunk; airborne mango and monkey throwing hand read immediately. Buddy turns away beside Heather lower leg while looking back; no merge.

inspection.inspection: Read complete primary in rendered browser from title to final provenance using overlapping viewport screenshots and AX text. Inspected each embedded illustration at its actual 960px reading width, then continued through its following prose. DOM observation confirmed all three images loaded. Screenshots are in this reviewer tool transcript; no separate screenshot files saved.
coverage: Opening airport/taxi and interrupted grand speech
Courtyard greeting, first image and water transition
Rickshaw corrections and market cloth exchange
Monkey throw, ammunition glance and second image
Window/blanket third image, closing dialogue and affectionate payoff
inspection.not_claimed: This reading inspection is not a new native-resolution anatomical review; that separate work is pinned in visual-review-v002.json.

observations.humor_and_timing: The airport horn triggers a second horn interruption just when Neet is about to repeat his speech; Buddy’s What is literal and does not overexplain. The seated welcome committee extends the territorial warning into a patient standoff. Neet’s immediate Right after the driver disobeys his Left gives a short physical reversal. The cloth/fruit exchange briefly makes both brothers ridiculous. The cart full of ammunition silently answers Is that all you’ve got without an extra explanatory quip.
observations.voices: Neet’s expansive commands and claimed retreat remain distinct from Buddy’s literal, dry practical replies. Buddy is more than a commentator: he initiates a successful greeting, chooses shelter in the rickshaw, overreacts to cloth, and pulls Heather toward the exit. Heather’s water instruction, amused international-incident remark and final Tomorrow form a practical, affectionate voice.
observations.causality_and_pacing: Arrival leads naturally to neighbors; next-day transport leads to market overstimulation and monkey provocation; Buddy identifies an exit and draws Heather into intervention; exhaustion leads to the opposing window/blanket choices. Paragraph breaks preserve short spoken responses and the pictures fall between completed beats, never between dialogue and attribution.
observations.emotional_payoff: Buddy achieves the quiet he has sought throughout, while Neet still enjoys discovery and leans into Heather’s touch. The opening horn returns at the close but is gently postponed to tomorrow. The final image precedes the That’s the plan exchange and stroke, so it supports rather than displaces the earned ending.
observations.complementary_images: Three different functions and compositions: social confrontation at the gate, diagonal active fruit threat in the market, and still opposing attention/rest indoors. Images are not redundant portraits; three is justified for this compact progression.
observations.continuity_and_source_limits: No Sagar import or new chronology claim. Historical breed/weight wording remains story voice; illustrations are not evidence of those measurements. Style and partial human appearances remain provisional.
